description: This file defines JSON serialization settings and custom converters for types used in Orleans Redis clustering, including IPAddress, IPEndPoint, and SiloAddress.

classes.name: JsonSettings
classes.description: Provides static JSON serializer settings with custom converters for network-related types used in Orleans Redis clustering.

classes.name: IPAddressConverter
classes.description: Custom JSON converter for IPAddress type, serializing to string and deserializing from string.

classes.name: IPEndPointConverter
classes.description: Custom JSON converter for IPEndPoint type, serializing as an object with Address and Port properties.

classes.name: SiloAddressConverter
classes.description: Custom JSON converter for SiloAddress type, serializing as a string and deserializing from a string.

methods.name: JsonSerializerSettings
methods.description: Provides configured JsonSerializerSettings with custom converters and specific serialization options.

methods.name: CanConvert
methods.description: Determines if the converter can handle the specified object type.
